description.value: Wolf Brewing Company is a craft brewery and taproom in Nanaimo, Vancouver Island, serving small-batch beers on 10+ taps including a nitro pour from their on-site brewery. Their kitchen turns spent brewing grain into pizza crust, and local Vancouver Island artists design each beer label. The dog-friendly patio, live music nights, and proximity to the Nanaimo Ferry Terminals and Airport make it a natural gathering point for cyclists arriving on or departing the island.
